description: Data shipped with the fuseaip release. train1/test1 are the DeepAIP official split minus the 385 dual-function peptides listed in conflicts_385.csv. Cross-validation folds are NOT stored in the data: every trainer derives them at runtime with StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) over train1.csv in file order (see README, Cross-validation protocol).

train1.csv.note: no fold column: folds are recomputed at runtime from the row order + labels.

test1.csv.note: never used for fitting or for threshold selection.

conflicts_385.csv.note: documentation only: the peptides removed from train0/test0 to build train1/test1 (305 + 80 rows). Nothing in the pipeline reads this file.

cv.note: Derived at runtime by every trainer. build_splits.py prints the per-fold sizes/positives and a short hash of each fold's row ids and compares them to the reference block below (advisory: a mismatch means a different scikit-learn release reshuffled the folds).
